# Lisbon

Four days in Lisbon in late spring. Tram 28 climbs through Alfama past the cathedral, and the miradouros at Graça and Santa Luzia look over the red roofs down to the Tagus. Belém is a short train ride west: the monastery, the tower and the custard tarts at the old bakery. Evenings were for fado in a tiny bar near the castle walls.
